<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Delivers PRD 001 req-23 and starts c-skill (the `/pij community` route itself is s10, which links to these files). Sources: docs/project/README.md, docs/project/workshops/001-pij-community/002-limits-and-doc-prompting.md (points 6 to 8), the three schemas in .dd/schemas/pij/, and PRD 001, blueprint 001 and roadmap 001 as the live example. Also closes s01, which #108 merged but left in-progress.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A PM can write a PRD, a blueprint and a roadmap that validate and link, from one short procedure per type.
- A PM can fold a ruling into existing docs without deleting rows.
- The procedure says who writes: the PM that owns the work, with the prime helping; the prime itself when the operator asks.
- Roadmap steps name the roles they need (`needs`), as workshop 002 point 8 says.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- The `/pij community` route and its registry row (s10).
- Role templates (s03).
- New schemas or schema changes. If the procedure exposes a schema gap, record it as a follow-up note to pm-001.
